title: Vertical readiness
description: These signals come from the business's current configuration. Items needing attention are guidance and never block checkout by themselves.
noProfile: Choose a business type above to see a checklist tailored to the way this business operates.

catalog.label: Sellable catalog
catalog.hint: {{count}} active products are available to this business.

productUnits.label: Product units
productUnits.hint: {{count}} active products have at least one configured sales unit.

fractionalSales.label: Fractional quantities
fractionalSales.hint: {{count}} products are configured for measured or cut quantities.

lotTracking.label: Lot traceability
lotTracking.hint: {{count}} active products require lot-level stock handling.

serializedInventory.label: Serialized inventory
serializedInventory.hint: {{count}} products preserve one physical identity per sold unit.

weightedBarcode.label: Weight barcode scanner
weightedBarcode.hint: {{count}} active site scanners have valid GS1 weight or price decoding.

transformationRecipes.label: Transformations and recipes
transformationRecipes.hint: {{count}} active recipes match this operating profile.

pharmacyCatalog.label: Pharmacy catalog data
pharmacyCatalog.hint: {{count}} active products have a pharmaceutical profile.

pharmacyPolicy.label: Effective pharmacy policy
pharmacyPolicy.hint: {{count}} pharmaceutical products have a sale classification allowed by the current country policy.

restaurantTables.label: Table map
restaurantTables.hint: {{count}} active tables are configured for dine-in service.

kdsStations.label: Kitchen stations
kdsStations.hint: {{count}} active KDS stations can receive routed preparation lines.

customerDisplay.label: Customer Display
customerDisplay.hint: {{count}} privacy-minimal local display module is enabled.

disclaimer: These signals verify application configuration only. They do not certify legal compliance, physical hardware or a live operating pilot.
